meta.title: VMS / VRP Import: refused for a user without the Implementation Partner role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Locate and attempt the VMS/VRP Import action and observe whether it is absent or refused
Repeat the import attempt as an Implementation Partner and verify the action is available
Verify whether Enterprise plan configuration or tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role on the specified Enterprise tenant; Locate and attempt the VMS/VRP Import action and observe whether it is absent or refused; Repeat the import attempt as an Implementation Partner and verify the action is available; Verify whether Enterprise plan configuration or tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles

args.need: sign in as the non-Implementation Partner user and the Implementation Partner on the same Enterprise tenant, attempt VMS/VRP Import for each, and record whether the action is absent, refused, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as role-specific users or reach and evaluate the VMS/VRP Import permission boundary.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester's comparison.
